notes: Item 19 for HOT DOG ON A STICK (HDOS) discloses three sets of tables for the 2024 calendar year: Part I (All Restaurants, n=41), Part II (Company Owned Restaurants, n=28), and Part III (Franchised Restaurants, n=13). Each part contains 4 tables: (1) Net Sales by restaurant format, (2) Range of Net Sales distribution, (3) Food Cost as % of Net Sales, and (4) Labor Cost as % of Net Sales. Table 2 (Range of Net Sales distribution) has been omitted from the records as it provides range band counts rather than cohort-level avg/median/min/max for a single cohort. All percentage fields are reported as percentages (not decimals). The FDD notes data is unaudited and based on internal financial statements and franchisee-provided royalty/financial reports. Some sub-segments (Other, In-Line) had 0 units in the company-owned set and are omitted from those records.
